main_text.l: EX causis, quas attulistis, pro deponendis Principibus Ca-
tholicis, prima fuit iuris vsurpatio in Electione Episcopo-
rum, & Abbatum; quùm tamen Pontifices Rom.diù Imper-
tores[?] Constantinopolitanos pacificè tulerint, etiamsi {a}Absq;
eorum[?] confirmatione, & nisi solutâ prius pro Confirmatione pecu-
niâ Pontifices ordinari non poterant: tandem Agatho I. Papa
An.Dom.DCLXXXIX.[?] hoc priuilegium ab Imperatore abtinuit,
vt hàc pessimâ confuetudine sublatâ, Pontifex electus non sine
Imperatoris assensu consecraretur, quæ ille gratis dare tenebatur.
Secunda est Iniuria in Papam, qui sæpè sine causa quiri-
tatur; quid igitur? Cùm Princeps aut à Papa ad Concilium
prouocandū censuerit; aut Calceū Pontificis exosculari recu-
sauerit: si Papa de illata sibi iniuria vehementius postula-
uerit; an propterea Coronâ suâ spoliandus est Princeps? * In-
iusta oratio; cùm præsertim complures Pontifices nefarias
& immanes iniurias in suos Prædecessores exercuisse con-
fteant, nec tamen Pontificatu abdicati sint.
Tertia, Arrogatio Iuris in tollendo Schismate tum gli-
scente

page.notes: Doubtful readings: "itàin" (line-start word, spacing unclear); "Imper-tores" at the line end, the second part of the word is uncertain; the year "DCLXXXIX" is read from the reversed-C numerals and may be misread; the stray "e" mark before "rum" after "Absq;" is not explained by a margin note, and I have kept only the "a" mark; the mark before "Noli" was read as "z" and is uncertain. The "Sect: XV." label is set in the margin beside the heading and is placed inside that heading. The "Cap.2." in the running head is included as printed. The "*" marks before "Iniusta" and after "confugerunt." are printed asterisks, kept as they stand. The paragraph "Tertia..." runs on to the next page.
